namespace = cosmo_asiapu_events



# Royal Marriage hakka Subject
country_event = {
	id = cosmo_asiapu_events.10103
	title = cosmo_asiapu_events.10103.t
	desc = cosmo_asiapu_events.10103.d
	picture = cosmogfx_PALACE_MENU_10A_1_eventPicture

	is_triggered_only = yes		

	immediate = {
	hidden_effect = {
				random_known_country = {
				limit = {
					has_opinion_modifier = {
						who = ROOT
						modifier = cosmo_sending_proposal
					}
				}
					save_event_target_as = proposalcountry
				}
				random_subject_country = {
			limit = {
		cosmo_asian_personal_union_subject_trigger = yes

			OR = {
				primary_culture = hakka
			}
			}
					save_event_target_as = proposalcountry
				}										
		}
	}	

		option = {
		name = cosmo_asiapu_events.10103.a 
		trigger = {
		has_regency = no 	
		OR = {
			has_consort = no	
			has_estate = estate_harem 	
			has_estate = estate_wives 	
			has_estate = estate_forbiddenpalace 	
			has_estate = estate_ooku 				
		}
		}
		set_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_ruler
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
		#proposal country
		country_event = {#royal wedding FROM
			id = cosmo_asiapu_events.101098
			}
		}				
	}
		option = {
		name = cosmo_asiapu_events.10103.b 
		trigger = {
			has_heir = yes
		NOT = {
			has_ruler_modifier = cosmo_heir_married
		}
		}
		add_ruler_modifier = {
			name = cosmo_heir_married
			duration = -1  
			desc = cosmo_heir_married_DESC

				}		
		set_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_heir
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
		#proposal country
		country_event = {#royal wedding FROM
			id = cosmo_asiapu_events.101098
			}
		}
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
			remove_opinion = {
					who = ROOT
					modifier = cosmo_sending_proposal
				}
		}						
	}
		option = {#uncleson
		name = cosmo_asiapu_events.10103.c 
		trigger = {
			has_heir = yes
		NOT = {
			has_ruler_modifier = cosmo_heir_married
		}
		}
		add_ruler_modifier = {
			name = cosmo_heir_married
			duration = -1  
			desc = cosmo_heir_married_DESC

				}		
		set_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_uncleson
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
		#proposal country
		country_event = {#royal wedding FROM
			id = cosmo_asiapu_events.101098
			}
		}
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
			remove_opinion = {
					who = ROOT
					modifier = cosmo_sending_proposal
				}
		}						
	}	
		option = {#reject
		name = cosmo_asiapu_events.10103.7 
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
			remove_opinion = {
					who = ROOT
					modifier = cosmo_sending_proposal
				}
		}						
	}
		
}

# Royal Marriage hakka Subject
country_event = {
	id = cosmo_asiapu_events.10101
	title = cosmo_asiapu_events.10101.t
	desc = cosmo_asiapu_events.10101.d
	picture = cosmogfx_PALACE_MENU_10A_1_eventPicture

	is_triggered_only = yes		

	immediate = {
	hidden_effect = {
		every_owned_province = {
			limit = {
			OR = {
				superregion = china_superregion
				superregion = east_indies_superregion
				superregion = oceania_superregion
				superregion = far_east_superregion
				superregion = india_superregion
			}	
			}
			set_province_flag = hakka_honeymoon_possible_here
		}
		every_subject_country = {
		every_owned_province = {
			limit = {
			OR = {
				superregion = china_superregion
				superregion = east_indies_superregion
				superregion = oceania_superregion
				superregion = far_east_superregion
				superregion = india_superregion
			}	
			}
			set_province_flag = hakka_honeymoon_possible_here
		}			
		}
				random_province = {
				limit = {
					has_province_flag = hakka_honeymoon_possible_here
					country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT 
				}
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}
				random_province = {
				limit = {
					has_province_flag = hakka_honeymoon_possible_here
					country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT 
					has_port = yes 					
				}
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}				
				random_province = {
				limit = {
					has_province_flag = hakka_honeymoon_possible_here
					country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT 
					province_has_center_of_trade_of_level = 1					
				}
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}
				random_province = {
				limit = {
					has_province_flag = hakka_honeymoon_possible_here
					country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT 
					province_has_center_of_trade_of_level = 2					
				}
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}
				random_province = {
				limit = {
					has_province_flag = hakka_honeymoon_possible_here
					country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT 
					province_has_center_of_trade_of_level = 2
					has_port = yes 					
				}
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}
				random_subject_country = {
				limit = {
					capital_scope = {
						superregion = china_superregion
						has_province_flag = hakka_honeymoon_possible_here
					}
				}
				capital_scope = {
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}	
				}										
		}
	}	

		option = {
		name = cosmo_asiapu_events.10101.a 
		FROM = {
			capital_scope = { #testdelete
			set_province_flag = hakka_honeymoon_first_stop	
			}
		}
		create_marriage = FROM
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_ruler
			}				
		define_consort = {
			country_of_origin = FROM
			dynasty = FROM
			religion = FROM
			culture = FROM
			female = yes
		}
		set_consort_flag = cosmo_consort
		set_consort_flag = cosmo_palace_10a
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				FROM = {
					NOT = {
				cosmo_asian_personal_union_subject_trigger = yes
					}
				}				
				}
				create_subject = { 
					subject_type = cosmo_asian_personal_union_I	
					subject = FROM	
					}
				join_all_offensive_wars_of = FROM
				join_all_defensive_wars_of = FROM	
				FROM = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_reform = pirate_republic_reform
					}
					hidden_effect = {
					change_government = monarchy 
					}
					add_government_reform = cosmo_pirate_kingdom 					
				}
				}	
			}
				country_event = {#honeymoon first
					id = cosmo_asiapu_events.101031
					days = 30
					random = 15					
					}
		hidden_effect = {
				trigger_switch = {
		on_trigger = has_ruler_flag
		royal_marriage_ruler = {
			set_country_flag = hakka_ruler_honeymoon
			clr_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_ruler
			}
		cosmo_heir_married = {
			set_country_flag = hakka_heir_honeymoon
			clr_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_heir
			}
		royal_marriage_uncleson = {
			set_country_flag = hakka_uncle_honeymoon
			clr_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_uncleson
			}
		}
		}			
	}		
}

			# put in immediate NOT = { has_any_active_estate_agenda = yes }

			if = {

				}
				start_estate_agenda = estate_nobleaffairs			
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_estate = estate_ooku 
				}
				start_estate_agenda = estate_ooku			
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_estate = estate_wives 
				}
				start_estate_agenda = estate_wives			
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_estate = estate_harem 
				}

			if = {
				limit = {

				}
				start_estate_agenda = estate_forbiddenpalace			
			}		 
		event_target:personalunion = {
			tooltip = {
				join_all_offensive_wars_of = ROOT

	id = cosmo_asiapu_events.152041
	title = cosmo_asiapu_events.152041.t
	desc = cosmo_asiapu_events.152041.d

	trigger = {
	NOT = {

			which = cosmoPalaceFifteenBCounter	
			value = 1
			}
		}
			}

	}

	}	
	}
	picture = cosmogfx_PALACE_MENU_15B_6_eventPicture
	}
	picture = {
	trigger = {
	NOT = {	
	check_variable = {
			which = cosmoPalaceFifteenBCounter
			value = 121
			}
	}	
	}
	picture = cosmogfx_PALACE_MENU_15B_7_eventPicture
	}
	picture = {
	trigger = {
	NOT = {	
	check_variable = {
			which = cosmoPalaceFifteenBCounter
			value = 141
			}
	}	
	}
	picture = cosmogfx_PALACE_MENU_15B_8_eventPicture
	}

			}
	}	
	}
	picture = cosmogfx_PALACE_MENU_15B_5_eventPicture #2nd
	}

	is_triggered_only = yes		

	immediate = {
	hidden_effect = {
				random_province = {
				limit = {
					has_province_flag = honeymoon_first_stop
					country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT 
				}
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}
				random_list = {
				25 = { #adm
						set_ruler_flag = honeymoon_consort_bonus
				}
				25 = { #dip
					trigger = {
					NOT = {
						has_ruler_flag = has_honeymoon_monarchpoints
					}						
					}
						set_ruler_flag = honeymoon_ruler_bonus
	
				}
				25 = { #mil
						set_ruler_flag = honeymoon_province_bonus
				}
				25 = { #mil
						set_ruler_flag = honeymoon_fertility_bonus
				}																								
			}
				random_list = {
				33 = { #adm
						set_ruler_flag = honeymoon_bonus_1
				}
				33 = { #dip
						set_ruler_flag = honeymoon_bonus_2
	
				}
				33 = { #mil
						set_ruler_flag = honeymoon_bonus_3
				}																								
			}								
	}
	}	

		option = {
		name = cosmo_asiapu_events.152041.a 
		trigger = {
			has_consort = yes		
				}
		if = {
			limit = {
			has_global_flag = cosmo_buildings_active
			}
			custom_tooltip = royal_visit_building_hmoonactive_tt
		}		
		event_target:honeymoonprovince = {
			add_province_modifier = { 
				name = honeymoon_visit
				duration = 90 
				desc = honeymoon_visit_DESC
	
			}
		}										
				trigger_switch = {
					on_trigger = has_ruler_flag
					honeymoon_consort_bonus = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							has_ruler_flag = honeymoon_bonus_1	
						}
						remove_queen_personality = zealot_personality  
						add_queen_personality = tolerant_personality 
						}
					if = {
						limit = {
							has_ruler_flag = honeymoon_bonus_2	
						}
						remove_queen_personality = babbling_buffoon_personality  
						remove_queen_personality = naive_personality  
						add_queen_personality = silver_tongue_personality
						}
					if = {
						limit = {
							has_ruler_flag = honeymoon_bonus_3	
						}
						remove_queen_personality = infertile_personality  
						add_queen_personality = fertile_personality
						}										
					}
					honeymoon_ruler_bonus = {
						set_ruler_flag = has_honeymoon_monarchpoints
						if = {
							limit = {
							event_target:honeymoonprovince = {
							controller = {
								is_subject_of = ROOT
							} 	
						}	
							}
							change_dip = 1				
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
							event_target:honeymoonprovince = {
							owned_by = ROOT 	
						}	
							}
							change_adm = 1				
						}																		
						}
					honeymoon_province_bonus = {
						if = {
							limit = {
							event_target:honeymoonprovince = {
							controller = {
								is_subject_of = ROOT
							} 	
						}	
							}
						event_target:honeymoonprovince = {
							add_scaled_local_dip_power = 1 	
						}
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
							event_target:honeymoonprovince = {
							owned_by = ROOT 	
						}	
							}
						event_target:honeymoonprovince = {
							add_scaled_local_adm_power = 1 	
						}
						}																
						}
					honeymoon_fertility_bonus = {
						add_ruler_modifier = {
							name = cosmo_fertile_ruler
							duration = -1  
							desc = cosmo_fertile_ruler_DESC
							hidden = no				
						}
					}																
				}	
			country_event = { 
			id = cosmo_asiapu_events.152042
			    days = 30
				random = 15
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_consort_bonus
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_ruler_bonus
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_province_bonus
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_bonus_1
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_bonus_2
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_bonus_3
			}
		hidden_effect = {
		change_variable = {
		which = cosmoPalaceFifteenBCounter
		value = 20
		}
		if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
			which = cosmoPalaceFifteenBCounter	
			value = 280
			}
			}
		set_variable = {
		which = cosmoPalaceFifteenBCounter
		value = 0
			}
		}
	}					
	}
		option = {#end early
		name = cosmo_asiapu_events.152041.b
		remove_country_modifier = cosmo_on_honeymoon 
			hidden_effect = {
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_consort_bonus
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_ruler_bonus
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_province_bonus
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_bonus_1
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_bonus_2
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_bonus_3
				every_province = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							has_province_flag = honeymoon_possible_here
							has_province_flag = honeymoon_first_stop
						}
					}
					clr_province_flag = honeymoon_possible_here
					clr_province_flag = honeymoon_first_stop
				}
			}
		hidden_effect = {
		change_variable = {
		which = cosmoPalaceFifteenBCounter
		value = 20
		}
		if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
			which = cosmoPalaceFifteenBCounter	
			value = 280
			}
			}
		set_variable = {
		which = cosmoPalaceFifteenBCounter
		value = 0
			}
		}
	}										
	}			
}

					}

				join_all_defensive_wars_of = FROM

				if = {
					limit = {
						has_reform = pirate_republic_reform
					}
					hidden_effect = {
					change_government = monarchy 
					}
					add_government_reform = cosmo_pirate_kingdom 					
				}
				}	
			}
				country_event = {#honeymoon first
					id = cosmo_asiapu_events.153031
					days = 30
					random = 15					
					}
		hidden_effect = {
				trigger_switch = {
		on_trigger = has_ruler_flag
		royal_marriage_ruler = {

				modifier = cosmo_strengthen_union
			}
		}
		}

			}

		}
		every_country = {

				has_country_flag = cosmo_wants_to_join_war

		}		
	}
